# GeTopFloor

> GeTopFloor is an interactive 3D virtual skyscraper and live attention market. Startups and founders claim floors on the digital tower to showcase their companies, earn backlinks, and gain high-intent visibility from founders and investors worldwide.

## Overview
- **Website**: https://getopfloor.com
- **Type**: Interactive 3D WebGL Platform / Startup Discovery / Digital Sponsorship
- **Pricing**: Dynamic starting from ₹50 INR (one-time placement fee)
- **Fulfillment**: 100% instant, automated digital delivery upon checkout
- **Payment Provider**: Dodo Payments (Cards, UPI, International Payments)

## Core Concepts

### 1. The 50-Floor Skyscraper
GeTopFloor features exactly 50 visible floors rendered in high-performance Three.js 3D WebGL.
- **Penthouse Floor #1**: The summit of the skyscraper, commanding maximum visibility, attention, and traffic.
- **Dynamic Outbid Hierarchy**: Any founder can outbid the current price to claim Floor #1. When a new company claims Floor #1, all existing floors shift down one rank atomically in PostgreSQL.
- **Floor Discard**: When all 50 floors are filled, claiming Top Floor #1 gently pushes the bottom-most floor out of the active skyscraper.

### 3. Self-Service Management (CRUD)
Every claim generates a secret `manage_token` stored in the user's browser:
- **View Floor**: Retrieve live floor rank, price paid, and click impressions.
- **Update Details**: Update company title, website destination URL, tagline, category, description, and logo.
- **Vacate Floor**: Reset floor back to an available premium slot at any time.

## API Endpoints
- `GET /api/floors`: Returns current active 50 floors with company names, ranks, categories, and URLs.
- `POST /api/checkout`: Initiates Dodo Payments checkout session with custom amount and return URL.
- `GET /api/floors/manage?token=...`: Fetches private floor details for verified owner.
- `PATCH /api/floors/manage`: Updates floor copy, URL, and category using secret manage token.
- `DELETE /api/floors/manage?token=...`: Vacates floor.
